cf_1.speaker: Rowan
cf_1.text: Iris always shuts me down. Every time I want to push, to try, she slams the door.

cf_2.speaker: Iris
cf_2.text: Because last time we ‘tried’, we got hurt. I was the one who had to hold us together afterward.

cf_choice.speaker: You
cf_choice.text: They are both afraid of the same thing. How do you help them meet in the middle?

choices.text: Tell Rowan to just back off.

cf_good.speaker: Narration
cf_good.text: Something eases. "I don't want us hurt either," Rowan says quietly. Iris nods. The bond between them steadies.

cf_bad.speaker: Narration
cf_bad.text: Rowan goes quiet — not resolved, just pushed down. The bond frays further, and that tension will follow whoever you send today.
